title: Rig Relay Tool Receipt Index v1
description: Content-light indexed receipt record derived from session observability events. Contains no raw tool output, file contents, diffs, snippets, or secrets — only metadata, hashes, byte counts, and structured error classification.

session_id.description: Session identifier that produced the receipt

event_id.description: Unique event identifier from the observability envelope

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the receipt was captured

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that produced the receipt (e.g. bash, search_replace)

invocation_id.description: Invocation or call identifier, if available

status.description: Tool execution outcome status (success, failure, refused, timed_out, etc.)

error_kind.description: Structured error classification when status is not success

refusal_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is refused

changed.description: Whether the tool invocation mutated files (search_replace only)

path.description: Primary file path affected by the tool, if applicable (resolved absolute)

before_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of file content before mutation (search_replace only)

after_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of file content after mutation (search_replace only)

stdout_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of stdout content (bash only)

stderr_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of stderr content (bash only)
